content:
Hello,

I've been working on an encoding of Pi calculus in the context of CsLib, and I'm wondering if anyone has also done some work in that direction / if it interests anyone to work on it
Also, I took great inspiration from the work already present with CCS, should I still mention the author of CCS as the begining of my files ?

If you've copy-pasted a substantial amount of CCS to start, I'd appreciate it (just listing me among the authors is fine).
We have an MSc student over here doing the session-typed pi-calculus, but it's probably a bit different from what you're doing if you're doing the pure pi-calculus.
I'd be glad to help out, and I know of at least another person who might, if you'd like collaborators.
I would be interested to see what is done on the session-typed pi-calculus !
I made the fork yesterday (but i feel like i don't respect all of the guidelines, still a draft) :https://github.com/DanaelCarbonneau/cslib
